author: keyhantgh
quote: This is a good boyfriend simulator game. There is no way to cheat, have another girlfriend or have meeting which others, same for Lucia. The map is big but nothing special. It is full of different bugs. The story is boring, the game is 30 fps but in ps5 slim is some scenes to can feel the fps drop to 20 fps. It is not a 2 billion dollars game. They have lied to us. If they tried to create it like gta san Andreas, it could be better. Yes Rockstar spent 2 billion dollars, but not for the game, for critic reviews.
